about.title: Hi, I'm Muhammad Sabilil Fajri
about.bio: I design interfaces, build web applications, and test how they work. My experience spans finance, production scheduling, and ERP systems, with one shared focus: understanding the workflows of the people who use them.

uiux.title: UI/UX Design
uiux.description: Understanding user workflows, mapping wireframes, and making prototypes in Figma. I develop the designs through conversations with product teams and feedback from users.

webdev.title: Web Development
webdev.description: Connecting interfaces, APIs, and databases into working web applications. I also handle deployment so the features I build can be tried and used.

qa.title: Quality Assurance
qa.description: Testing key workflows, investigating bugs, and checking fixes. Automated tests with Jest and Playwright help me check changes before an application is released.
